# P0 PRODUCTION RELIABILITY — 503 RECOVERY

## FINAL STATUS: **VERIFIED**
The exact 503 scenario was reproduced live, recovered automatically, and completed **without losing the owner request**.

## Root cause of the 503 (instrumented, not guessed)
1. **Application-generated**: `ivx-owner-ai.ts` mapped `configuration_missing`/`relation_missing` failures → HTTP 503 in code
2. **Render-edge**: platform 503s during deploy/restart windows (never reach app code)
3. **Timeout-converted**: client held the request open with a 58s ceiling while long executions kept running server-side
4. The old request-control layer was **in-memory only** — erased on every restart, and it never executed work

## What is now live (runtime `90532dadf94d`)
- **Durable task queue** (`ivx_owner_ai_tasks`): persist-first, task ID returned in 202 immediately, background worker off the HTTP path, transient-only retries (429/502/503/504/timeout) with backoff+jitter, dead-letter + replay, restart recovery, idempotency dedup
- **Split health**: `/health/live|ready|ai|database|queue|provider` — `/ready` now returns 503 when the Owner AI path is down (no more false "healthy")
- **5xx instrumentation**: every 5xx on the route recorded with trace ID, duration, exact source (`/api/ivx/owner-ai/incidents`)
- **App**: auto-fallback to the durable queue on transient failure, task ID + status + checkpoint visible, cancel/manual retry, message never retyped, pending answers restored after app restart

## Live proof (task IDs)
- **503 reproduced + auto-recovered**: task `5493bbd8` — ATTEMPT_1_FAILED `HTTP_503_TRANSIENT` → backoff → ATTEMPT_2_FAILED → attempt 3 **VERIFIED** "RECOVERED-AFTER-503", reply persisted to your chat
- Normal task `79e86c7b` VERIFIED 2.7s · duplicate send → **same** task (no double execution) · dead-letter `d75ef01e` → replay → VERIFIED · cancel (queued AND in-flight) + manual retry proven · 3-task congestion all VERIFIED · **Render restarted mid-battery** (worker `sld27i1b`→`kx6pmoe9`) and tasks completed on the new instance
- **Exact failed request re-run**: `POST /api/ivx/owner-ai` → HTTP 200 in 4.2s

## Evidence
Commits `99c31561`/`7274d876`/`f686c1ad`/`170d6226`/`f7987530`/`90532dad`=HEAD · SHA parity GitHub=Render=/health · tests 18/18 (472 assertions), 0 type errors · Phase 6 audit: canonical Supabase config present, direct Postgres URLs genuinely absent — **no credentials needed from you** · Ledger `49118252` · report in your chat (msg `3174d7cc`)

**Remaining (owner-device only):** on-phone network-interruption and background/reopen acceptance — the client code is shipped and engages automatically.
